h1: Email sign-up forms and recovery emails
overview: We set up a sign-up form that collects emails politely, then the automatic emails that follow. A welcome email greets new subscribers, and a cart recovery email reminds people who left items behind. Everything is built inside your own email tool, such as Klaviyo or Mailchimp, with your brand colors and clear unsubscribe links. We write the emails with you, test each one and show you how to read the results.

faq: Which email tools do you use?
Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Shopify Email and similar tools. Tell us what you use, or we suggest a fair-priced option for your list size. Subscription fees are billed to you.
Will you email my customers without asking?
No. We build the flows and test them with our own addresses, and nothing is sent to your list until you approve it. We follow consent and unsubscribe rules.
Do popups hurt my search ranking?
Not when they are set up properly. We delay popups, keep them easy to close on phones and avoid blocking the whole screen, so they do not annoy shoppers.
Can you send my newsletters too?
This service sets up the forms and automatic emails only. Regular campaigns can be quoted separately, once the basics are working.
